English: Steam Pit
A shallow earthen pit lined with heated stones, where water is poured to create steam. Used by the clan for basic cleansing and ritual health among the nomads.
Hot Stone Hut
A simple wooden hut built to trap heat from stones, providing a more controlled environment for cleansing and gathering. Offers improved unity and health for the tribe.
Smoke Sauna
A sturdy log structure filled with wood smoke, used to purify the body and spirit. The experience strengthens clan bonds and resilience.
Birch Switch Room
A chamber lined with birch branches for ritual cleansing and invigoration. Encourages stronger unity and increases the health and vigor of the people.
Wooden Bath Pavilion
A spacious pavilion constructed of seasoned timber, accommodating larger groups for collective bathing and ceremonies. Greatly improves clan health and population growth.
Community Bathhouse
A large, well-organized bathhouse of timber and stone, serving as a communal center for ritual, diplomacy, and health. Increases manpower and unity across the clan.
Warmed Hall
A grand hall with advanced heating, serving as an important gathering place for deliberation and celebration. Promotes rapid growth and unity among the clan.
Heated Room
A refined chamber with stone floors and advanced heating, providing a luxurious and healthful environment for the elite of the clan.
Family Bath Chamber
An elegant private chamber for the leading families, with multiple pools and elaborate heating. Enhances prestige, health, and loyalty among the clans nobility.
South Slavic Banya

The crowning achievement: a monumental stone and timber bathhouse with multiple halls, pools, and ritual spaces. Unites the tribe in health, prosperity, and pride, and serves as a symbol of the clans greatness.
